column1: # The third-party images that run in an environment's cluster, each pinned by digest upstream: the
# one list of them (release/README.md, "第三方镜像"). Nothing runs them from upstream: every install
# copies them by digest into the environment's own repository colvenna-lake-<env>/third-party, tagged
# <name>-<the digest's first 12 hex digits>, and the charts, scripts and tests run that copy
# (lib/common.sh's third_party_image). A source install copies them from the release registry when
# it holds them, else from upstream (deploy/scripts/foundation/copy-third-party.sh); a release
# candidate keeps them in colvenna-lake-release/third-party (make-manifest.sh) and a release install
# copies them from there (release/install-images.sh). Upstream registries drop digests: quay.io
# rebuilds a release's tag on a new base and deletes the old index.
# Columns, tab-separated: name, scope, the upstream reference
# (<registry>/<repository>[:<tag>]@sha256:<digest>), and what runs it. The scope says which installs
# copy it: platform, every install, for the platform and for the acceptance cases that apply to a
# platform-only install (test_third_party.py checks it from docs/uat and run-uat.sh); fixtures, only
# installs with --fixtures. The nodes are x86_64 Linux: an index that carries Windows images too is
# pinned by its linux/amd64 manifest, a digest of its own upstream, so that a copy is not gigabytes
